text:
```yaml
name: Docker CI Container Image

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        make dockerfile
        make format/yaml

    - name: Build Docker image
      run: |
        docker build -t vald-dev-container .

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        make test

    - name: Push Docker image
      uses: docker/build-push-action@v2
      with:
        context: .
        push: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' }}
        tags: vdaas/vald-dev-container:${{ github.sha }}
```

This workflow will build and test the Docker image for the `vald-dev-container` whenever changes are pushed to the `main` branch or a pull request is opened against the `main` branch. It includes steps to set up Go, install dependencies, build the Docker image, run tests, and push the Docker image to a registry if the event is a push.
